about: Lumiverb's own install of this plug-in (src/server/own_plugins.py), not the protocol: the server settings it takes from the install's settings once, when it's first installed, unless the server admin chose them. Its mirror is LUMIVERB_GEONAMES_URL's, from when Lumiverb fetched GeoNames' lists itself, when that names a copy rather than GeoNames.
